content.comment_body: Hello, I have a USB cable to connect my PC to the [product_name] device, and I'm using SUSE 10.3. The required driver (cp2101.ko) appears in the kernel, but I still can't establish a connection. Any suggestions would be appreciated. Regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered issues connecting their PC to a [product_name] device via USB on Linux (SUSE 10.3), even though the necessary driver is detected in the kernel. This indicates possible compatibility or communication problems between Linux drivers and [company_name] products, which may hinder Linux users from easily using these devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that, once the necessary driver is confirmed to be installed, USB connectivity between their PC and the [product_name] device should work reliably on Linux.
